title: Engram usage skill: the exchange guard's rerun-import recovery should resume the exchange at the removal check, so the imported commit gets recorded
outcome: Engram usage skill: the exchange guard's rerun-import recovery should resume the exchange at the removal check, so the imported commit gets recorded
acceptance: The exchange guard's recovery for a transient refusal tells the agent to resume the exchange at the removal-check step for the resulting HEAD, so that the removal check, the dry run and the imported-commit record all run before any push

Optional clarity: the merge-commit sentences apply only while a merge is in progress (a fast-forward needs no commit), and the publish step's check for an existing remote data branch names `git -C .engram-data ls-remote origin engram-data`
